summary: Setup-day gate relaxation + roster-upload safety-net review. Backend gate unit-checks all PASS (duty_hours=12 → tomorrow, night_flight → +2, cap at +2 verified). Retry-with-zero-workouts flow WORKS end-to-end — job flips to status='needs_review' AND a high-priority coach task (task_type='roster_plan_generation_issue') is opened via _open_coach_task_for_stuck_generation. Frontend Home loads without crash; when no active job no banner appears; brand-red 'plan-preparing-banner' renders correctly when a queued/processing job is stubbed. Regressions PASS: Coach LIBRARY tab opens V2 Unified Exercise Library, /event shows category chips + medical safety copy, NEXT 7 DAYS still starts with 'Today', no standalone 'AI' on client Home. HOWEVER — 1 CRITICAL BACKEND BUG blocks the safety-net UI: GET /api/roster/jobs/active only returns jobs with status IN [queued, processing] (server.py:2570). needs_review / partial / failed jobs are excluded, so the amber 'plan-needs-review-banner' cannot ever render even though the frontend branch exists. Verified live: with a stub {status:'needs_review'} roster_jobs doc for the seeded client, the endpoint returned {} and the amber banner did NOT render.

critical.issue: Query filters status to ['queued','processing'] only, so jobs with status needs_review/partial/failed never surface. As a direct consequence the frontend amber banner (plan-needs-review-banner) in home.tsx cannot render — the whole safety-net UX is silent. Fix: broaden the query to also return recent needs_review / partial / failed jobs (recommend last 48h and not yet client-acknowledged) so the amber banner triggers. server.py:2569-2574.

integration_issues.issue: home.tsx correctly renders the amber banner when rosterJob.status in {needs_review, partial, failed}, but the upstream endpoint /api/roster/jobs/active never returns those statuses (see backend critical bug), so this branch is dead code today.

action_items: CRITICAL: Widen GET /api/roster/jobs/active (server.py:2569) to also return the user's most recent needs_review / partial / failed job (e.g. within last 48h, or where a new client_acknowledged flag is false). Without this, the amber 'plan-needs-review-banner' — the entire client-facing part of this iteration's safety net — will never render.
MINOR: Consider passing the 'stage' field through to home.tsx so the preparing-banner can show progress % when >0.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py roster_active_job returns only queued/processing — reason for this restriction is defensible (only 'live' work), but the frontend now depends on the same endpoint to render both banners. Either (a) broaden the endpoint or (b) add a second endpoint (e.g. /roster/jobs/last-review) and call both from home.tsx.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (needs_review banner never renders): The mongo filter in server.py:2570 restricts to {status: {$in: ['queued','processing']}} whereas the frontend contract requires the same endpoint to surface needs_review/partial/failed jobs. Reproduction: (1) insert a roster_jobs doc for a user with status='needs_review'; (2) call GET /api/roster/jobs/active as that user → returns {}; (3) reload client Home → no banner. Fix: extend the $in list to include ['queued','processing','needs_review','partial','failed'] (optionally add an updated_at cutoff or a client_acknowledged flag so old failures don't linger forever). No other code change needed — the frontend already handles all three amber statuses correctly.
